The '''y'limerson dewbell''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. Y'limerson dewbell cuttings were often planted on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival|Spring Abundance Festival]] at the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:Cultivation">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=weekly|Cultivation|Dantooine}}</ref>
